title: ESQL Ensure that the error delta is positive in PercentileIntGroupingAggregatorFunctionTests

timeline.message: Ensure that the error delta is positive
timeline.author: ChrisHegarty

timeline.body:
This commit fixes the usage of an error delta in a test. Hamcrest's closeTo matcher does not like it when we give it a negative delta!

closes #99160
it's kinda surprises me that we need to so this. In the failure scenario, the `expected` is -`1.0`

timeline.author: ChrisHegarty
